text: Dodging grants a brief moment where incoming attacks cannot harm you.
zh: 闪避可获得短暂的无敌时间，期间来袭的攻击无法伤害你。

text:
Use ###input.INPUT_SKILL_SECONDARY### or ###input.INPUT_SKILL_TERTIARY### to activate whichever dodge skill you have assigned.
Some items provide improved dodge or backstep skills.
zh:
按###input.INPUT_SKILL_SECONDARY###或###input.INPUT_SKILL_TERTIARY###可发动你已装备的闪避技能。
部分物品可提供强化的闪避或后跳技能。
